title: How the Iran war is transforming the relationship between stocks, bonds and oil
summary: Rising oil prices driven by the Iran conflict are significantly affecting global markets, creating volatility across stocks, bonds, and commodities. Energy prices are now a key driver of investor sentiment and market movements.
content: Oil is increasingly calling the tune in global markets as rising energy prices make investors nervous.

zh.title: 伊朗战争如何改变股票、债券和石油之间的关系
zh.summary: 伊朗冲突推高的油价正在显著影响全球市场，导致股票、债券和大宗商品市场出现波动。能源价格现已成为投资者情绪和市场动向的主要驱动力。

title: Canada invited to become EU’s first ‘associate member’ as Trump trade war intensifies
summary: The EU is inviting Canada to become its first associate member as trade tensions with the Trump administration escalate. This partnership would deepen EU-Canada ties in response to shifting global trade dynamics.
content: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said the bloc wants to open the door for Canada to become its first associate member, signaling a major deepening of ties.

zh.title: 在特朗普贸易战加剧之际，加拿大被邀请成为欧盟首个"准成员"
zh.summary: 欧盟邀请加拿大成为其首个准成员，因为与特朗普政府的贸易紧张局势升级。这一伙伴关系将加深欧盟与加拿大的联系，以应对不断变化的全球贸易动态。

title: Budweiser's parent is a buy thanks to its strong presence in emerging markets, says Deutsche Bank
summary: Deutsche Bank upgraded AB InBev (Budweiser's parent) to a buy rating, citing the company's strong growth prospects in emerging markets. The upgrade reflects confidence in the brewer's international expansion strategy.
content: The investment bank upgraded AB InBev to buy from hold.

zh.title: 德意志银行表示，由于在新兴市场的强势地位，百威英博值得买入
zh.summary: 德意志银行将AB InBev（百威英博的母公司）升级为买入评级，理由是该公司在新兴市场的强劲增长前景。这次升级反映了对这家啤酒制造商国际扩张战略的信心。

title: Petrol and diesel price rises push UK inflation higher
summary: UK inflation increased in recent months due to higher petrol and diesel prices, driven by summer travel demand and Middle East supply disruptions. Energy costs are a major contributor to overall price growth.
content: Summer holidays and disruption to global oil supplies by the Middle East conflict stoked price growth.

zh.title: 汽油和柴油价格上升推高英国通胀
zh.summary: 英国通胀在近几个月上升，原因是汽油和柴油价格上升，由暑期旅游需求和中东供应中断驱动。能源成本是整体价格增长的主要贡献者。

title: 5% Treasury yields mean America’s debt bill just got a lot bigger
summary: Treasury yields reaching 5% significantly increase the U.S. government's borrowing costs and debt servicing obligations. Higher yields worsen long-term fiscal challenges if they remain elevated.
content: Treasury yields haven’t been this high in years — and the fiscal math gets uglier the longer they stay there.

zh.title: 5%国债收益率意味着美国债务账单大幅增加
zh.summary: 国债收益率达到5%显著增加了美国政府的借贷成本和债务偿付义务。如果收益率保持在高位，更高的收益率会加重长期财政挑战。

title: Inflation killed the penny. Now it’s coming for your dollar.
summary: Rising inflation is eroding the value of U.S. currency, following the penny's obsolescence due to inflation. The article questions whether Congress addressed the root cause of currency devaluation.
content: Congress congratulated itself for solving the penny problem, but what about the source of the problem — inflation?

zh.title: 通胀杀死了便士。现在它来对付你的美元了。
zh.summary: 上升的通胀正在侵蚀美元价值，继便士因通胀而过时之后。这篇文章质疑国会是否解决了货币贬值的根本原因。

title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
summary: Intel and SK Hynix shares rose on reports of potential collaboration on U.S. memory chip manufacturing. A partnership would help Intel secure major customers for its foundry business.
content: The deal could be a big win for Intel which has been looking to gain marquee customers for its manufacturing, or foundry, business.

zh.title: 英特尔和SK海力士股价因讨论美国芯片制造协议报道而上涨
zh.summary: 英特尔和SK海力士股价因潜在合作美国芯片制造的报道而上涨。这一伙伴关系将帮助英特尔为其代工业务获得主要客户。

title: Flyers are happier with U.S. airports, despite near record travel levels, J.D. Power report shows
summary: U.S. airport satisfaction ratings improved despite record travel volumes, driven by recent infrastructure upgrades including new gates and terminals. Passenger experience improvements are translating into higher customer satisfaction.
content: Travelers gave higher ratings in part because of the newer gates and terminals many airports have opened in recent years, according to the study.

zh.title: 尽管旅行人数接近创纪录水平，美国机场乘客满意度提高，J.D. Power报告显示
zh.summary: 美国机场满意度评级提高，尽管旅行量创纪录，这得益于最近的基础设施升级，包括新航站楼和候机室。乘客体验改善转化为更高的客户满意度。

title: This BlackRock strategist opposes a Fed hike. Here are the funds she recommends.
summary: BlackRock strategist Gargi Pal Chaudhuri argues against a Fed rate hike and recommends a diversified approach emphasizing AI, quality stocks, and healthcare. Her strategy balances growth exposure with stability across sectors.
content: Gargi Pal Chaudhuri, of BlackRock, recommends investors stay invested in the artificial-intelligence sector but broaden into themes like quality and healthcare.

zh.title: 这位贝莱德策略师反对美联储加息。以下是她推荐的基金。
zh.summary: 贝莱德策略师Gargi Pal Chaudhuri反对美联储加息，并推荐强调人工智能、优质股票和医疗保健的多元化方法。她的策略在部门间平衡增长敞口和稳定性。

title: ‘I am drowning in debt’: I have $125,000 in credit-card debt. Will $9,000 in disability income affect my bankruptcy?
summary: A debtor with $125,000 in credit-card debt and $9,000 in annual disability income seeks bankruptcy guidance, concerned about how income affects eligibility. The situation exemplifies challenges faced by individuals managing high debt with limited income.
content: “I racked up this debt to cover my living expenses for two years without an income stream.”

zh.title: 《我在债务中溺水》：我有125,000美元的信用卡债务。9,000美元的残疾收入会影响我的破产申请吗？
zh.summary: 一名债务人持有125,000美元的信用卡债务和年度9,000美元的残疾收入，寻求破产指导，担心收入如何影响资格。这种情况典型了收入有限的个人管理高额债务所面临的挑战。

title: What is happening to UK prices?
summary: UK inflation increased in August, primarily driven by elevated petrol and diesel prices. Energy costs remain a key factor in overall price growth.
content: UK inflation rose in August, pushed up by higher petrol and diesel prices.

zh.title: 英国物价发生了什么？
zh.summary: 英国8月份通货膨胀上升，主要由汽油和柴油价格上升推动。能源成本仍然是整体物价增长的关键因素。

title: What history says about longer-term bond yields after the first Fed hike
summary: Historical data suggests Fed rate hikes are unlikely to control the rapid rise in longer-term Treasury yields. The analysis questions the effectiveness of traditional monetary policy tools in the current environment.
content: If the Federal Reserve hikes interest rates in an effort to slow down the rapid rise in longer-term yields, history shows it probably won’t be a success.

zh.title: 历史对首次美联储加息后长期债券收益率的启示
zh.summary: 历史数据表明，美联储加息不太可能控制长期国债收益率的快速上升。该分析质疑传统货币政策工具在当前环境中的有效性。

title: Yield on 10-year Treasury hovers above 5% as investors await Fed decision
summary: The 10-year Treasury yield remains above 5% as markets anticipate a Federal Reserve rate hike. The elevated yield reflects expectations for tighter monetary policy.
content: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to hike interest rates on Wednesday.

zh.title: 10年期国债收益率在投资者等待美联储决策期间徘徊在5%以上
zh.summary: 随着市场预期美联储加息，10年期国债收益率保持在5%以上。高收益率反映了市场对更紧缩货币政策的预期。

title: What Altman, Amodei, Huang and Zuckerberg are saying about the raging AI debate
summary: Tech leaders at a Salesforce conference are divided on whether AI development should be slowed, with prominent figures voicing different perspectives on the pace and safety of AI advancement. The debate reflects growing concerns about rapid AI progress.
content: A product conference at software giant Salesforce turned into the battleground on the new debate on whether there should be a slowdown in artificial intelligence.

zh.title: Altman、Amodei、Huang和Zuckerberg关于激烈AI辩论的言论
zh.summary: 在Salesforce会议上，科技领袖对是否应该放慢AI开发速度意见不一，知名人士对AI进步的速度和安全性表达了不同看法。这场辩论反映了人们对AI快速发展的日益增长的担忧。

title: Crypto exchange Binance takes on tradfi by courting rich investors to join its expanded wealth-management platform
summary: Binance is expanding into traditional wealth management by opening its Capital Connect platform to qualified investors. The move signals crypto's increasing competition with established financial services for high-net-worth clients.
content: Binance is opening its Capital Connect platform to qualified individual investors for the first time.

zh.title: 加密交易所币安通过吸引富裕投资者加入其扩展的财富管理平台来挑战传统金融
zh.summary: 币安通过向合格投资者开放其Capital Connect平台来扩展传统财富管理业务。此举表明加密行业与既有金融服务机构在争夺高净值客户方面的竞争不断加剧。

title: Stock futures are little changed ahead of pivotal Fed rate decision: Live updates
summary: Stock futures show minimal movement as traders anticipate a potential new rate hiking cycle from the Federal Reserve, a key factor influencing near-term market direction.
content: Traders brace for the possibility of a new rate hiking cycle from the Federal Reserve.

zh.title: 股票期货在美联储关键利率决议前涨跌不大：实时更新
zh.summary: 股票期货显示最少的波动，因为交易员预期美联储可能启动新的加息周期，这是影响近期市场方向的关键因素。

title: BOJ expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to fresh three-decade high: CNBC survey
summary: The Bank of Japan is expected to raise rates by 25 basis points to its highest level in three decades, signaling continued efforts to normalize monetary policy.
content: The BOJ is expected to hike rates by 25 basis points to a fresh three-decade high, a CNBC survey shows.

zh.title: 日本央行预期加息25个基点至三十年高位：CNBC调查
zh.summary: 日本央行预期加息25个基点至三十年来的最高水平，表明继续努力实现货币政策正常化。

title: Indonesia's new finance minister faces an uphill battle on fiscal credibility
summary: Indonesia's newly appointed finance minister Nazara, a former deputy minister with extensive fiscal policy experience, faces significant challenges in restoring fiscal credibility after his predecessor's dismissal.
content: Nazara, sworn in hours after Purbaya's dismissal, spent seven years as deputy finance minister and led the ministry's fiscal policy agency from 2015 to 2019.

zh.title: 印度尼西亚新财政部长在财政信誉方面面临艰巨挑战
zh.summary: 印度尼西亚新任财政部长纳扎拉是前副部长，拥有丰富的财政政策经验，在前任被解职后面临恢复财政信誉的重大挑战。

title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but 'should trust' AI firms
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledges legitimate fears about AI's impact but urges trust in technology firms; executives claim economic incentives naturally limit AI advancement risks.
content: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

zh.title: OpenAI首席执行官表示世界"有理由感到害怕"但"应该信任"AI公司
zh.summary: OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman承认人们对AI影响的合理担忧，但敦促相信科技公司；高管声称经济激励自然限制了AI进步的风险。

title: House to vote on bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
summary: Bipartisan legislation would establish a regulatory framework enabling states to prevent data center operators from passing utility costs onto consumers.
content: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

zh.title: 众议院将投票表决限制AI数据中心公用事业成本的法案
zh.summary: 两党立法将建立监管框架，使各州能够阻止数据中心运营商将公用事业成本转嫁给消费者。
